instruction: Open Terminal and run songsee to create a multi-panel visualization of "$HOME/Desktop/Ode to Joy.mp3" featuring the panels spectrogram,mel,hpss,selfsim. Configure it to begin at 35 seconds with a duration of 10 seconds, apply the gray style, set dimensions to 1920 wide by 1080 tall, use a window size of 4096 and hop length of 768, and restrict the frequency range between 120 Hz and 6000 Hz. Save the output as a PNG file to "$HOME/Desktop/songsee_combo_4.png".
reference_command: songsee "$HOME/Desktop/Ode to Joy.mp3" --viz spectrogram,mel,hpss,selfsim --start 35 --duration 10 --style gray --width 1920 --height 1080 --window 4096 --hop 768 --min-freq 120 --max-freq 6000 --format png -o "$HOME/Desktop/songsee_combo_4.png"
